primary_business_goal: Convert developers and businesses to start integration
copy_summary: Bold headline 'Financial infrastructure for the internet' with animated gradient background. Company logos showing scale. Clean navigation to Products, Solutions, Developers, Resources.
notes: The gradient animation is distinctive and memorable. 'Financial infrastructure' positions Stripe as foundational, not just a tool. Company logos (Amazon, Google, etc.) provide massive social proof. Two clear paths: self-serve and sales-assisted.

primary_user_goal: Understand the product suite and find relevant solutions
primary_business_goal: Showcase breadth of offerings and enable self-qualification
copy_summary: Product grid: Payments, Billing, Connect, Radar, Atlas, etc. Each with icon, name, and one-line description.
notes: The product complexity is managed through clean categorization. Each product has its own page for deep dives. Icons help differentiate products quickly. This is progressive disclosure done well.

primary_business_goal: Enable self-serve integration and reduce support burden
copy_summary: Documentation overview with getting started guide, API reference sidebar, and code examples. Language selector for code samples.
notes: Stripe's documentation is legendary. Code-first approach with working examples. Language selector respects developer preference. The three-column layout allows navigation while reading content.

primary_business_goal: Get developers to first successful API call
copy_summary: Step-by-step quickstart: Install SDK, Add API key, Create checkout session, Test payment. Copy-paste code blocks with syntax highlighting.
notes: The quickstart is optimized for time-to-first-payment. Code is copy-pasteable. Test mode keys provided immediately. Each step has clear success criteria.

primary_business_goal: Provide actionable insights and drive feature adoption
copy_summary: Dashboard home showing gross volume, successful payments, new customers. Quick actions and recent activity. Test/Live mode toggle prominent.
notes: Test/Live mode toggle is prominent - critical for developers. Key metrics immediately visible. The card-based layout makes different data types scannable. Onboarding checklist for new accounts.

primary_business_goal: Enable transaction management and issue resolution
copy_summary: Payments table with status, amount, customer, date columns. Filters for status, date range, amount. Quick actions on each row.
notes: Table is highly functional with sortable columns. Status badges use color effectively. Filters are comprehensive but not overwhelming. Pagination handles large datasets.

primary_user_goal: Investigate specific payment and take action if needed
primary_business_goal: Enable issue resolution and reduce support tickets
copy_summary: Payment detail showing: Amount, status, customer info, payment method, timeline of events, metadata. Actions: Refund, capture, resend receipt.
notes: Complete audit trail with timeline. All related objects linked (customer, invoice, etc.). Actions are contextual based on payment state. Metadata display helps debugging.

primary_user_goal: Complete account setup to start accepting payments
copy_summary: Account activation form collecting: Business type, Country, Business details. Progress indicator shows steps remaining.
notes: Compliance requirements are complex but form breaks them into digestible steps. Inline validation prevents errors. Help text explains why information is needed. Can save progress and return.

copy_summary: Stripe Checkout showing order summary, payment methods (card, Apple Pay, Google Pay), email for receipt. Powered by Stripe badge.
notes: Stripe Checkout is optimized for conversion. Multiple payment methods reduce friction. Input masking for card numbers. Real-time validation. Trust signals (Stripe badge, lock icon). Mobile-optimized.
